शौण्ड, i. e. शुण्ड + अ, adj.
 1. Drunk, intoxicated.
 2. Addicted to liquor,

शौण्डिक, i. e. शुण्ड + इक,
 I. m. A distiller and vendor of spirituous liquors,

.
 II. f. की. A female keeper of a tavern, Böhtl. Ind.
शौण्डिकेय, i. e. शौण्डिक + एय, m. A demon, Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 531, 16.
